expectedVersion.description: Required on update (optimistic lock); must be absent on create

activeToday.description: Whether the Store-local today lies within [startDate, endDate] inclusive (rule P3)

salesWindowDays.description: Sales window N in days for v(i); omitted keeps the current value

timeZone.description: Must equal the Store calendar zone, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh in this release (decision D4).

lookbackDays.description: Complete calendar days analysed, ending the day before the analysis date. 7..365 inclusive (decision D3, amended 2026-11-02). Omitted: 30 for WEEKLY, 90 for MONTHLY. UI presets: 30, 60, 90, 180.

compareAlgorithms.description: Legacy stored value, retained for history only; new scheduled mining always uses EFIM without comparison.

algorithm.description: Fixed algorithm for all new requests.

confirmSimilarName.description: Set true only after confirming the similar-name warning returned with 409

imageUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTP(S) image URL for F09 display (no upload)

sku.description: Generated by the backend from the database product ID

stockQuantity.description: Derived sum of inventory batch remainingQuantity values

equalSizeBaselineScore.description: Layout B only (DEC-20261119-06): weighted utility score of the first N products of baseline A, N = distinct products in this B (all of A when N > |A|). Difference vs A for F07 = weightedUtilityScore - equalSizeBaselineScore. Null for layout A.

equalSizeProductCount.description: Layout B only: number of A products in that prefix, min(N, |A|). Null for layout A.

priorityCoverage.description: Share of distinct displayed products with frozen snapshot W > 1, rounded to six decimals. Null for an empty layout or unavailable frozen weight.

priorityCoverageDenominator.description: Number of distinct displayed products, including zero for an empty layout

sourceRecommendationId.description: F06 source recommendation; null means manually added

sku.description: Generated by the backend from the database product ID

expiryRisk.description: W2: U_expiry; null for legacy rows

seasonWeight.description: W2: M(i) season weight; null for legacy rows

seasonId.description: W2: frozen season that supplies M(i); null when none

progressPercent.description: Measured processedCount / totalCount; null when no exact nonzero total is known

conversionMode.description: SPMF input mode (DEC-20261119-05); null only for an unknown stored version

roundingUnit.description: Rounding unit in đồng of the SPMF input: 1 for WHOLE_UNIT_HALF_UP, null for LOSSLESS (exact scale 6)

RecTransactionEvidence.description: Presence counts from one immutable source dataset; ratios displayed at six decimal places, decisions use exact counts

inventoryChanged.description: Current fingerprint differs from the frozen one. True once for every recommendation created before W2 (fingerprint format changed)

expiryDate.description: Required when the product requires expiry tracking

pushDay.description: Store Admin push day used by F03 expiry risk (W2). Must be on or before expiryDate. A batch without one only warns and is excluded from expiry risk

batchCode.description: Generated as BATCH-YYYYMMDD-NNN; sequence is scoped to the Product

status.description: Stored status; writable through PATCH. Expiry is never stored: see effectiveStatus

daysToExpiry.description: expiryDate minus today in whole days: 0 on the expiry date, negative when expired, null without an expiry date. 'Expiring soon' = effectiveStatus is not EXPIRED and 0 <= daysToExpiry <= 7

effectiveStatus.description: Computed on read in the Store time zone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh): EXPIRED when today is AFTER expiryDate (on the expiry date itself the batch is still active); EXPIRED wins over BLOCKED; otherwise the stored status. Never writable; clients must not compare dates themselves

warnings.description: Always present (empty when there is nothing to warn about). MISSING_PUSH_DAY: the product requires expiry, pushDay is empty and effectiveStatus is not EXPIRED. Saving is still allowed; the push day is never auto-filled

priorityCoverage.description: Distinct priority products divided by actual displayed product count on this comparison side. Uses frozen W > 1. Null when unavailable or on historical reports without the metric.

priorityCoverageDenominator.description: Actual distinct displayed product count on this comparison side. Null on historical reports without the metric.

pushDay.description: Set the push day; counts toward the at-least-one-field rule. Must be on or before expiryDate

expiryDate.description: Set a corrected expiry date; null/omitted means unchanged. Clear with DELETE /api/inventory-batches/{id}/expiry-date

deleted.description: True when the product was soft-deleted (DEC-20261124-03): the assignment is kept for history, can be removed, and cannot be created again

seasonWeight.description: Current M(i): weight of the highest active assigned season, else 0

seasonId.description: Season that supplies M(i); null when M(i)=0 from no season

weightValue.description: Current Backend Weight preview (2 decimals), not a frozen historical Weight. Null when ready=false

batchesMissingPushDay.description: ACTIVE batches with stock and no push day; excluded from Q_risk and Q_eligible

activeSeasons.description: Seasons active on asOfDate that include this product

supportCount.description: Not measured by SPMF; always null

conversionMode.description: SPMF input mode derived from conversionVersion (DEC-20261119-05)

roundingUnit.description: Rounding unit in đồng: 1 for WHOLE_UNIT_HALF_UP, null for LOSSLESS

compareAlgorithms.description: Legacy stored value, retained for history only; the occurrence runs EFIM without comparison.

failureMessage.description: Actionable final cause of a FAILED occurrence (decision D7); null otherwise.

skipReason.description: Set only for SKIPPED: a missed fire time superseded by a later one (decision D6).

totalQuantity.description: Every remaining unit, whatever the status

sellableQuantity.description: Stored ACTIVE and not expired (a batch expiring today is sellable); no expiry date counts as not expired

expiredQuantity.description: Expired batches (today is after the expiry date) whatever their stored status: EXPIRED wins over BLOCKED

blockedQuantity.description: Stored BLOCKED and not expired; never overlaps expiredQuantity

expiringSoonQuantity.description: Sellable quantity with 0 <= daysToExpiry <= expiringWithinDays (today through the inclusive lookahead date)

batchesMissingPushDay.description: Batches of an expiry-tracked product with no push day that are not expired (the MISSING_PUSH_DAY warning count)

expiryWindowDays.description: Legacy Store setting; ignored since v1.2
